# =============================================================================
# Alpha Ablation: RASP pruning with alpha ∈ {0.0, 0.25, 0.5, 1.0, 2.0}
#
# Pipeline per alpha: prune → SFT warmup → GRPO Stage 2
# GPU allocation: two alpha values run in parallel (GPU0 + GPU1)
#
# Usage:
#   bash scripts/run_alpha_ablation.sh prune       # Phase 1: pruning only
#   bash scripts/run_alpha_ablation.sh sft          # Phase 2: SFT recovery
#   bash scripts/run_alpha_ablation.sh grpo         # Phase 3: GRPO RLVR
#   bash scripts/run_alpha_ablation.sh eval         # Phase 4: full GSM8K eval
#   bash scripts/run_alpha_ablation.sh all          # all phases sequentially
# =============================================================================

set -euo pipefail

source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base
cd /root/recovery_aware_struct_prune

# === Paths ===
MODEL="/root/autodl-tmp/DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B"
IMPORTANCE="results/importance_scores.pt"
CKA="results/cka_scores.pt"
DATA_ROOT="/root/autodl-tmp/recovery_aware_struct_prune"
LOG_DIR="${DATA_ROOT}/logs"
EVAL_DIR="${DATA_ROOT}/eval_results/alpha_ablation"
mkdir -p "$LOG_DIR" "$EVAL_DIR"

ALPHAS=(0.0 0.25 0.5 1.0 2.0)
ALPHA_TAGS=(alpha00 alpha025 alpha05 alpha10 alpha20)
SPARSITY=0.20

# === Phase 1: Pruning ===
run_prune() {
    echo "========== Phase 1: Pruning (alpha ablation) =========="
    for i in "${!ALPHAS[@]}"; do
        alpha="${ALPHAS[$i]}"
        tag="${ALPHA_TAGS[$i]}"
        output="/root/autodl-tmp/pruned_rasp_20_${tag}"

        # Reuse existing alpha=1.0 result
        if [ "$alpha" = "1.0" ] && [ -d "/root/autodl-tmp/pruned_rasp_20" ] && [ ! -d "$output" ]; then
            ln -s /root/autodl-tmp/pruned_rasp_20 "$output"
            echo "[REUSE] ${tag} linked from /root/autodl-tmp/pruned_rasp_20"
            continue
        fi

        if [ -d "$output" ]; then
            echo "[SKIP] $tag already exists: $output"
            continue
        fi

        echo "[START] Pruning alpha=${alpha} -> ${output}"
        python src/prune.py \
            --model_path "$MODEL" \
            --importance_path "$IMPORTANCE" \
            --cka_path "$CKA" \
            --mode rasp \
            --sparsity "$SPARSITY" \
            --alpha "$alpha" \
            --output_path "$output" \
            2>&1 | tee "${LOG_DIR}/prune_${tag}.log"
        echo "[DONE] Pruning alpha=${alpha}"
    done
    echo "========== Phase 1 Complete =========="
}

# === Phase 2: SFT Warmup ===
run_sft() {
    echo "========== Phase 2: SFT Warmup (alpha ablation) =========="

    for i in "${!ALPHAS[@]}"; do
        alpha="${ALPHAS[$i]}"
        tag="${ALPHA_TAGS[$i]}"
        pruned="/root/autodl-tmp/pruned_rasp_20_${tag}"
        sft_out="${DATA_ROOT}/sft_rasp_20_${tag}"

        if [ ! -d "$pruned" ]; then
            echo "[ERROR] Pruned model not found: $pruned (run 'prune' phase first)"
            continue
        fi

        if [ -d "$sft_out" ]; then
            echo "[SKIP] SFT $tag already exists: $sft_out"
            continue
        fi

        gpu=$((i % 2))
        echo "[START] SFT ${tag} on GPU${gpu}"
        CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=$gpu python src/train_sft_warmup.py \
            --model_path "$pruned" \
            --output_dir "$sft_out" \
            --gpu_id $gpu \
            --num_epochs 1 \
            --lr 2e-5 \
            2>&1 | tee "${LOG_DIR}/sft_${tag}.log" &

        if [ $gpu -eq 1 ] || [ $i -eq $((${#ALPHAS[@]} - 1)) ]; then
            wait
        fi
    done

    echo "========== Phase 2 Complete =========="
}

# === Phase 3: GRPO Stage 2 ===
run_grpo() {
    echo "========== Phase 3: GRPO Stage 2 (alpha ablation) =========="

    for i in "${!ALPHAS[@]}"; do
        alpha="${ALPHAS[$i]}"
        tag="${ALPHA_TAGS[$i]}"
        sft_model="${DATA_ROOT}/sft_rasp_20_${tag}"
        grpo_out="${DATA_ROOT}/grpo_rasp_20_${tag}"

        if [ ! -d "$sft_model" ]; then
            echo "[ERROR] SFT model not found: $sft_model (run 'sft' phase first)"
            continue
        fi

        if [ -d "$grpo_out" ]; then
            echo "[SKIP] GRPO $tag already exists: $grpo_out"
            continue
        fi

        gpu=$((i % 2))
        echo "[START] GRPO ${tag} on GPU${gpu}"
        CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=$gpu python src/train_grpo.py \
            --model_path "$sft_model" \
            --output_dir "$grpo_out" \
            --gpu $gpu \
            --max_completion_length 4096 \
            --num_train_epochs 1 \
            --max_samples 2000 \
            --learning_rate 1e-6 \
            --save_steps 100 \
            --save_total_limit 3 \
            --reward_desert_patience 50 \
            --run_name "grpo_rasp_20_${tag}" \
            2>&1 | tee "${LOG_DIR}/grpo_${tag}.log" &

        if [ $gpu -eq 1 ] || [ $i -eq $((${#ALPHAS[@]} - 1)) ]; then
            wait
        fi
    done

    echo "========== Phase 3 Complete =========="
}

# === Phase 4: Eval ===
run_eval() {
    echo "========== Phase 4: Full GSM8K Eval (alpha ablation) =========="

    for i in "${!ALPHAS[@]}"; do
        tag="${ALPHA_TAGS[$i]}"

        for stage in pruned sft grpo; do
            case $stage in
                pruned) model_path="/root/autodl-tmp/pruned_rasp_20_${tag}" ;;
                sft)    model_path="${DATA_ROOT}/sft_rasp_20_${tag}" ;;
                grpo)   model_path="${DATA_ROOT}/grpo_rasp_20_${tag}" ;;
            esac

            eval_name="${stage}_rasp_20_${tag}"
            output="${EVAL_DIR}/eval_full_${eval_name}_greedy.json"

            if [ ! -d "$model_path" ]; then
                echo "[SKIP] Model not found: $model_path"
                continue
            fi

            if [ -f "$output" ]; then
                echo "[SKIP] Already evaluated: $output"
                continue
            fi

            gpu=$((i % 2))
            echo "[START] Eval ${eval_name} on GPU${gpu}"
            CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=$gpu python src/eval_gsm8k.py \
                --model_path "$model_path" \
                --output_path "$output" \
                --max_new_tokens 4096 \
                --dtype bfloat16 \
                2>&1 | tee "${LOG_DIR}/eval_${eval_name}.log" &

            if [ $gpu -eq 1 ] || [ $i -eq $((${#ALPHAS[@]} - 1)) ]; then
                wait
            fi
        done
    done

    echo "========== Phase 4 Complete =========="
    echo "Results:"
    ls -lh "$EVAL_DIR"/*.json 2>/dev/null || echo "No results yet."
}

# === Main ===
PHASE="${1:-all}"

case "$PHASE" in
    prune) run_prune ;;
    sft)   run_sft ;;
    grpo)  run_grpo ;;
    eval)  run_eval ;;
    all)   run_prune; run_sft; run_grpo; run_eval ;;
    *)     echo "Usage: $0 {prune|sft|grpo|eval|all}"; exit 1 ;;
esac

# =============================================================================
# Alpha Ablation v2: RASP scoring S(h) = I(h) × (1-F(h))^α
# α ∈ {0.0, 0.25, 0.5, 1.0, 2.0}, sparsity=20%, GSM8K N=100 fast eval
#
# Disk-safe: sequential prune → eval → delete per α value.
# α=1.0 reuses existing pruned model (no prune, no delete).
#
# Usage:
#   bash scripts/run_alpha_ablation_v2.sh            # run all
#   bash scripts/run_alpha_ablation_v2.sh --dry-run   # validate setup only
# =============================================================================

set -euo pipefail

source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base
cd /root/recovery_aware_struct_prune

# --- Config ---
MODEL="/root/autodl-tmp/DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B"
IMPORTANCE="results/importance_scores.pt"
CKA="results/cka_scores.pt"
DATA_ROOT="/root/autodl-tmp/recovery_aware_struct_prune"
EVAL_DIR="${DATA_ROOT}/eval_results/alpha_ablation"
LOG_DIR="${DATA_ROOT}/logs"
SPARSITY=0.20
EVAL_SAMPLES=100
EXISTING_ALPHA10="/root/autodl-tmp/pruned_rasp_20"

ALPHAS=(0.0 0.25 0.5 1.0 2.0)

DRY_RUN=false
if [[ "${1:-}" == "--dry-run" ]]; then
    DRY_RUN=true
fi

mkdir -p "$EVAL_DIR" "$LOG_DIR"

# --- Auto GPU selection: pick the GPU with most free memory ---
select_gpu() {
    local gpu
    gpu=$(python3 -c "
import torch
if not torch.cuda.is_available():
    print(0); exit()
free = []
for i in range(min(torch.cuda.device_count(), 2)):
    free.append((torch.cuda.mem_get_info(i)[0], i))
print(sorted(free, reverse=True)[0][1])
" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
    echo "$gpu"
}

GPU=$(select_gpu)
echo "=========================================="
echo "Alpha Ablation v2 (RASP scoring)"
echo "  Alphas: ${ALPHAS[*]}"
echo "  Sparsity: ${SPARSITY}"
echo "  Eval samples: ${EVAL_SAMPLES}"
echo "  GPU: cuda:${GPU}"
echo "  Start: $(date)"
echo "=========================================="

# --- Dry-run checks ---
if $DRY_RUN; then
    echo ""
    echo "[DRY-RUN] Validating setup..."
    errors=0

    # Check base model
    if [ -d "$MODEL" ]; then
        echo "  [OK] Base model: $MODEL"
    else
        echo "  [FAIL] Base model not found: $MODEL"; ((errors++))
    fi

    # Check score files
    for f in "$IMPORTANCE" "$CKA"; do
        if [ -f "$f" ]; then
            echo "  [OK] Score file: $f ($(du -h "$f" | cut -f1))"
        else
            echo "  [FAIL] Score file not found: $f"; ((errors++))
        fi
    done

    # Check α=1.0 model
    if [ -d "$EXISTING_ALPHA10" ]; then
        echo "  [OK] α=1.0 model: $EXISTING_ALPHA10"
    else
        echo "  [FAIL] α=1.0 model not found: $EXISTING_ALPHA10"; ((errors++))
    fi

    # Check prune.py --alpha
    python src/prune.py --help 2>&1 | grep -q "\-\-alpha" && \
        echo "  [OK] prune.py supports --alpha" || \
        { echo "  [FAIL] prune.py missing --alpha flag"; ((errors++)); }

    # Check eval_gsm8k.py --max_samples
    python src/eval_gsm8k.py --help 2>&1 | grep -q "\-\-max_samples" && \
        echo "  [OK] eval_gsm8k.py supports --max_samples" || \
        { echo "  [FAIL] eval_gsm8k.py missing --max_samples flag"; ((errors++)); }

    # Check disk
    avail_gb=$(df --output=avail /root/autodl-tmp | tail -1)
    avail_gb=$((avail_gb / 1024 / 1024))
    if [ "$avail_gb" -ge 15 ]; then
        echo "  [OK] Disk: ${avail_gb}GB free (need ~12GB per prune cycle)"
    else
        echo "  [WARN] Disk: only ${avail_gb}GB free"; ((errors++))
    fi

    # Check existing results
    echo ""
    echo "  Existing results:"
    for alpha in "${ALPHAS[@]}"; do
        tag=$(echo "$alpha" | tr '.' '_')
        result="${EVAL_DIR}/eval_alpha_${tag}.json"
        if [ -f "$result" ]; then
            echo "    α=${alpha}: DONE ($(du -h "$result" | cut -f1))"
        else
            echo "    α=${alpha}: pending"
        fi
    done

    echo ""
    if [ $errors -eq 0 ]; then
        echo "[DRY-RUN] All checks passed. Ready to run."
    else
        echo "[DRY-RUN] ${errors} issue(s) found."
    fi
    exit 0
fi

# --- Main loop: sequential prune → eval → cleanup ---
for alpha in "${ALPHAS[@]}"; do
    tag=$(echo "$alpha" | tr '.' '_')
    eval_output="${EVAL_DIR}/eval_alpha_${tag}.json"

    # Skip if already evaluated
    if [ -f "$eval_output" ]; then
        echo "[SKIP] α=${alpha} already evaluated: ${eval_output}"
        continue
    fi

    echo ""

# GPU time estimate: ~2.5h (4 prune runs ~10min each + 5 evals ~25min each)

ABLATION_DIR="/root/autodl-tmp/recovery_aware_struct_prune/alpha_ablation"

        echo "[REUSE] alpha=1.0 linked from /root/autodl-tmp/pruned_rasp_20"
    fi

gpu_queue_0=()
gpu_queue_1=()
for i in "${!ALPHAS[@]}"; do
    alpha="${ALPHAS[$i]}"

    if [ "$alpha" = "1.0" ]; then

    tag="alpha_${alpha}"
    if [ -f "${ABLATION_DIR}/${tag}/pruning_metadata.pt" ]; then
